ANSWER: The function that builds the renamed conflict path is **`ConflictForkPath`** in **`pkg/sync/reconcile.go`**. It takes the original file path and the local `vault.TreeEntry`, calls `ConflictLocalPath` (also in `pkg/sync/reconcile.go`) to get the base `.conflict-local` name, then appends a short hash — the first 8 characters of `local.PlaintextHash` — to produce a unique path like `ideas.conflict-local-1a2b3c4d.md`. The plaintext hash (not the encrypted blob hash) is used so that the same content always maps to the same fork path regardless of which device encrypted it. `ApplyConflictFailsafe` (also in `pkg/sync/reconcile.go`) is the caller that applies this renamed path to the merged tree.

CONFIDENCE: high
